title: Out Riding Bikes You See Things Comic by JF Frankel
content:
Our buddy JF Frankel launched a comic book the week of the Made Bike Show called Out Riding Bikes You See Things. It’s retailing for $20 from his Etsy store. Here’s his description of the book:

“A magazine collection of my comics about riding bikes. Characters you meet on bike paths, group ride anxiety, wildlife encounters, component lust, protest rides, and more! Includes pieces that previously appeared on The Radavist, Calling In Sick magazine, and my own feeds. 8.5″ x 11″, 36 pages, full color. 100% human-made, with my own calloused mitts.”

We love having his work over here at The Radavist and are stoked to see his work in book form! Roll on over to his Etsy to check it out.
